reason: Re-opened the packet and the live revision 2354026 (10 January 2024): Wang Bi’s comment on 故抗兵相加，哀者勝矣, the line Legge translates in the key, is 抗，舉也；加，當也。哀者，必相惜而不趣利避害，故必勝, which carries every clause of the reading (cherish one another, neither chasing gain nor shunning harm, so sure to win). Hard passage on war: the plain sense states armies meeting plainly, without softening, and does not lean on Legge’s parentheses; Wang Bi sets no further limit on this line. The Heshang Gong comment (哀者慈仁，士卒不遠於死) is thinner, so Wang Bi is the better choice. verse.js ok (at [68]); entry-check ok at 45 words.
